sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B Muse Glimmer is Meta's 30B parameter open model built for local, agentic AI. It combines multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use, multimodal understanding, and failure recovery in a model designed to run on consumer hardware without requiring cloud infrastructure.
